name: Headline Digest
description: Turns NewsAPI top headlines into a short digest. The API key lives in Cindy's vault and is injected by the Host at request time — this plugin never sees it.
whenToUse: Use when the user asks for current headlines, top stories from a country, news about a specific topic, or a quick news digest — for example "what is happening in tech today", "top stories in Japan", or "headlines about the election".

newsapi_key.label: NewsAPI key
newsapi_key.hint: Free key from newsapi.org/register. Stored encrypted by Cindy and injected as the x-api-key header; the plugin cannot read it.

top_headlines.description: Fetch current top headlines from NewsAPI and return a compact digest. Requires the NewsAPI key the user saved through this plugin's settings; the Host injects it, so never ask for or pass a key yourself. Parameters: `query` (free text, optional), `country` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, default us), `category` (business, entertainment, general, health, science, sports, technology), `limit` (1-20, default 5). Returns JSON { count, query, country, category, articles: [{ title, source, url, publishedAt, description }], note } where `source` may be null and `description` is trimmed to 200 characters. `count: 0` with a note means the upstream service returned no matching articles, which is a successful result. This tool only reads: it makes one HTTPS GET to newsapi.org and changes nothing. If the saved key is missing or rejected the result is an actionable error telling the user where to fix it — relay that message as-is.
